verdict.rationale: Metronome's docs describe official developer SDKs for Python, Go, Ruby, Node.js and Java. A probe also confirms a published OpenAPI spec, which supports building against the API. missing for 10: SDK depth and coverage documentation beyond a single summary line, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The SDKs for Python, Go, Ruby, Node.js, and Java offer developers flexible options for implementing Metronome's capabilities across platforms and environments.
